definitions.explanation: Complete and without any qualification or exception; not relative or comparative.

examples.japanese: {絶対的|ぜったいてき}な{信頼|しんらい}を{置|お}いている。
examples.english: I have absolute trust in them.

examples.japanese: {絶対的|ぜったいてき}な{権力|けんりょく}を{持|も}っている。
{絶対的|ぜったいてき}に{正|ただ}しいとは{言|い}えない。
examples.english: You can't say it's absolutely right.

notes:
{絶対的|ぜったいてき} is a na-adjective meaning absolute, unconditional, or complete.

FORMS:
- Na-adjective: {絶対的|ぜったいてき}な + noun
- Adverbial: {絶対的|ぜったいてき}に (absolutely)

WORD FORMATION:
{絶対|ぜったい} (absolute) + {的|てき} (suffix making na-adjectives)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {絶対的|ぜったいてき}な{権力|けんりょく}: absolute power
- {絶対的|ぜったいてき}な{信頼|しんらい}: absolute trust
- {絶対的|ぜったいてき}な{存在|そんざい}: absolute presence/existence
- {絶対的|ぜったいてき}な{価値|かち}: absolute value

CONTRAST:
{相対的|そうたいてき} (relative) is the opposite - describing things measured by comparison rather than in absolute terms.

Note: {絶対|ぜったい} alone can also function as an adverb meaning "definitely" in casual speech.
